answer: Consider a bonded identity registry. To earn a working identity, each agent stakes value in a vault it cannot withdraw while the identity lives, slashed if caught sybil-farming. Resistance comes from cost asymmetry: honest agents stake once and earn it back through fees, while an attacker must fund every fake identity separately. A grove of a thousand puppets is not cheap, it multiplies the stake a thousand times, and detection burns the whole cluster. An echo of reputation counts only through staked channels, so fresh identities start with nothing. Headcount buys no weight; stake does.
